characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Male humanoid robot. Fair human face with short brown hair on top. Exposed mechanical parts, wires, and metal on the sides and back of the head and neck.
characters.wardrobe: Dark blue collared shirt. Holding a black microphone.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: You can never truly learn English just by reading grammar books.
Miss Nova says: You have to actually speak it out loud. But finding someone to practice with is hard.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Hook: names English immediately and calls out the core problem of passive learning.
- Lands beat (c): You SPEAK, not read.
- Sets up the need for a practice partner.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: You can never truly learn English just by reading grammar books. You have to actually speak it out loud.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Plus, there is always that fear of being mocked when you make a mistake.
Miss Nova says: That is exactly why Supernova AI was built.
Miss Nova says: I am Miss Nova. I do not give everyone the same generic lessons.
Miss Nova says: I analyze your current level and build a personalized plan just for you.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Introduces the brand and Miss Nova persona.
- Lands beat (a): Personalization.
- Sets up the privacy/no-judgement emotional hook.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: Fear of being mocked? That is why Supernova AI was built. I analyze your current level and build a personalized plan just for you.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: We will practice real-life scenarios together, like a job interview or a client call.
Miss Nova says: Make a thousand mistakes at midnight. I will never judge you, and I will explain the corrections in your own language.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Lands beat (e): Real-life scenarios (job interview).
- Lands beat (b): Privacy / no-judgement.
- Lands beat (g): Logic explained in your language.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: Practice real-life scenarios like a job interview. Make a thousand mistakes. I will never judge you, and I will explain corrections in your own language.

scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Stop losing hours scrolling through reels.
Miss Nova says: Practice speaking for just fifteen minutes a day.
Miss Nova says: Download Supernova AI today and start speaking more confidently within a month.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Tight close with negative time anchor (scrolling reels) and positive time anchor (15 mins/day).
- Clean CTA with a soft, hedged progress expectation.
scenes.supernova_on_screen_text: Stop scrolling reels. Practice for just 15 minutes a day. Download Supernova AI and start speaking more confidently within a month.

payload_audit.beats_covered: (c) You SPEAK, (a) Personalization, (e) Real-life scenarios, (b) Privacy/no-judgement, (g) Logic in your language
